title: An axis built from two ranges
description: "Under €15" spans two declared price bands. Listing them in scope.category selects the union, so the axis needs no third category re-listing the wines the first two already contain (spec §8.1.2). Crossing two axes is a different thing and is not expressible: the second ranking here shows why — adding the colour widens the selection instead of narrowing it.

rankings.label: Under €15
rankings.description: A union: either price band qualifies.

rankings.label: Under €15, or red
rankings.description: A union, not an intersection: B is red and costs more than €15, and it is selected all the same. There is no way to write "red AND under €15" other than declaring that category outright.
